Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses l)Vehicle must be registered in the name of bidding agency or proprietor. 2)There should be no penalty imposed on bidding agency or proprietor in the past 3 years . 3)Driver should be on the payroll of proprietor or bidding agency and should be residing in Ahmedabad.

4Vehicle must be of 2025/2026 make and shall be parked at officer's residence during whole contract per iod. 5) Driver should reside within 05 KM near officer's residence so that he may reach by two wheeler in time i n case of emergency call also mobile phone of seller as well as driver shall be on 24 hours during contract and shall be pick up whenever required.. 6) Bidder office should be based upon Ahmedabad. All the above conditions are compulsory for bidder and Offer would be rejected for non compliance. .
